description: Hyper-parameter tuning on the 2022 validation year (weighted metrics)
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity (fatal: MAXSEV_IM 9 excluded; ka: MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded, so ka rows are a subset); train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: Models fitted on 2016-2021 with survey weights; chosen = lowest weighted 2022 log loss; fatal metrics use every crash with a known fatal outcome; ka metrics use only the crashes where ka is known (MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded), so the two outcomes differ in n
